raw_segments.text: Ingmar said he was glad to hear that Helgham was still in the neighborhood.
The summer before the preacher had often dropped in at the mill to chat with Ingmar, and the
Ingmar thought him the finest chap he had ever met.
Never had he come across anyone who was so much of a man, so firm in his convictions,
Sometimes, when there had been a great rush of work at the mill, Helgham had pulled off
his coat and given them a lift.
Ingmar had been amazed at the man's cleverness.
He had never seen anyone who was so quick at his work.
Just then, Helgham happened to be away for a few days, but was expected back shortly.
